root_cause.text: The `v3d_rewrite_csd_job_wg_counts_from_indirect` function in the DRM V3D driver leaks virtual address mappings for buffer objects because an early return statement skips the cleanup logic when workgroup counts are zero.
root_cause.evidence: The patch modifies `drivers/gpu/drm/v3d/v3d_sched.c` by replacing `return;` with `goto unmap_bo;` inside the condition `if (wg_counts[0] == 0 || wg_counts[1] == 0 || wg_counts[2] == 0)`, ensuring the newly added `unmap_bo` label executes `v3d_put_bo_vaddr` for both buffers.
